admission.justification: Spans integrate.py, landing_briefs.py, and landing_answer_shapes.py, is guarded by dedicated integration and projection tests, and upholds the file-brief retrieval family guarantee after local landings.

applicability: External-memory final integrations and atomic-master checkpoint landings executed through worktree_integrate or worktree_checkpoint_landing.
conditions: Runs only after contract finalization succeeds and non-ledger memory content changed between the base and landed memory commits (excluding root memory.md).
Iterates checked-out worktrees owning the landed memory branch via branch_worktree_owners and delegates generation to WorktreeServices.file_briefs.
Surfaces any brief-refresh failure solely through the optional briefsProblem field retained in LANDING_KEPT_KEYS without altering returncode or reversing the landing.
exclusions: Ledger-only memory changes or dry-run previews do not trigger brief refresh.
Brief refresh failure never blocks, fails, or rolls back Git ref publication or contract landing recording.
statement: External-memory integrations and checkpoint landings refresh derived briefs on checked-out branch worktrees only after finalization when non-ledger memory content changes, reporting any refresh failure strictly as an advisory briefsProblem field.
title: Post-finalization landing briefs refresh and advisory briefsProblem
